**The capability** — what should become possible?

**Which side?** inbound / outbound / both.

**If a provider:** link the vendor's webhook documentation (signature scheme, headers,
timestamp/replay rules, batch shape). ash_hooks only ships providers whose signing scheme
is documented publicly and verified first-hand.
